title: timeline.split_clip
description: Split a clip at 'time' (sequence time) into left and right clips that inherit their media positions; 'time' must lie strictly inside the clip. 1:1 mapping to OPP/1 section 8.4 timeline.split_clip (the legacy 'clip_id' field was renamed to OPP's 'clip').

time.description: Split point on the sequence timeline.

oneOf.description: Frame index (>= 0). The T1 adapter converts it to Rational using the active sequence/footage frame rate and quantizes to the frame grid.
